g.text: Annual approved original principal — nominal and inflation-adjusted to 2025 USD
Source: World Bank Projects & Operations List; IBRD Statement of Loans and Guarantees (DS00047, snapshot 09/30/2026). Nominal = original principal at approval. Real
= adjusted using US GDP deflator (NY.GDP.DEFL.ZS, base 2020=100).
